about: Domains whose links on the blog's /tidings/ page open the archived copy (archive.catallenya.com/view/) instead of the original, because they sit behind a (usually metered) paywall. Edit freely; the blog reads this at build time. A domain also covers its subdomains.
source: Started as a copy of https://github.com/MostlyEmre/hn-anti-paywall/blob/main/paywalls.json (2026-10-01); cut the same day to the paywalled sites among the blog's own links, checked live: newyorker.com and wired.com are metered, theverge.com is declared paywalled (isAccessibleForFree: false).
